Returns & Exchange Policy

Baba Saleh Sportswear

At Baba Saleh Sportswear, we are committed to providing you with high-quality sportswear and a great shopping experience. However, we understand that sometimes a product may not meet your expectations. That’s why we offer a clear and fair return policy to ensure your satisfaction and build your trust.

Eligibility for Returns

We accept returns under the following conditions:

  • Timeframe: Items must be returned within 7 days from the original date of purchase.

  • Receipt Requirement: You must present the original sales receipt (physical or digital) as proof of purchase. Returns without a receipt cannot be processed.

  • Product Condition: The item must be in its original, unused condition – unworn, unwashed, and free from any damage, stains, or odors. All original tags, labels, and packaging must be intact and included.

Non-Returnable Items

To maintain health and hygiene standards, the following items are not eligible for return unless faulty or defective:

  • Undergarments (e.g., sports bras, compression wear)

  • Socks

  • Any item that has been worn, washed, or altered

  • Items marked as "final sale" or "clearance"

Exchange Policy

If you wish to exchange an item for a different size or color, the same 7-day return window applies. Exchanges are subject to product availability at the time of return. If the desired item is unavailable, we may offer a store credit or process it as a return instead.

Refund Method

  • Approved returns will be refunded using the same payment method used in the original transaction.

  • If the original purchase was made via credit/debit card, please allow 5–10 business days for the refund to reflect in your account, depending on your bank's policies.

  • In the case of cash purchases, refunds will be issued in cash upon approval of the return.

How to Return

You can return items by visiting the same branch where the original purchase was made (e.g., the October branch). Our staff will inspect the item to ensure it meets the return criteria before proceeding.

Damaged or Faulty Items

If you receive an item that is damaged, defective, or not as described, please contact us within 48 hours of purchase. We will evaluate the issue and offer an appropriate resolution, which may include a replacement, repair, or full refund.

At Baba Saleh Sports Egypt, customer satisfaction is our priority. Please read our Refund and Returns Policy carefully to understand your rights and obligations when returning a product.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 7 days from the date of delivery. If more than 7 days have passed since your purchase, unfortunately, we cannot offer you a refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return:

  • The item must be unused, unworn, and in the same condition that you received it.
  • It must be returned in its original packaging.
  • You must provide a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

Non-Returnable Items

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned, including but not limited to:

  • Underwear, Sports Bra, Personal Items
  • Health or personal care items
  • Intimate or sanitary goods
  • Hazardous materials
  • Flammable liquids or gases
  • Downloadable software
  • Gift cards

Partial Refunds (If Applicable)

Only partial refunds may be granted for:

  • Items with obvious signs of use
  • Items not in original condition, damaged, or missing parts not due to our error
  • Returns requested after the 7-day period but within a reasonable exception window (case-by-case basis)

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return, we will notify you by email about the approval or rejection of your refund.

If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will be applied automatically to your original method of payment within a few business days or cash upon visiting the relevant store.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet:

  1. Re-check your bank account.
  2. Contact your credit card provider — it may take time before the refund posts.
  3. Contact your bank — processing times can vary.

If you’ve done all this and still haven’t received your refund, please contact us at support@babasaleh.com.

Sale Items

Only regular-priced items are eligible for refunds. Sale or promotional items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange a product for the same item, email us at support@babasaleh.com. Please note that all exchanges are subject to availability.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be sent to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift, or was shipped to the purchaser first, we will send a refund to the gift giver.

Shipping Returns

To return your product, please bring it back to:
📍The relevant store you purchased the item from
(Note: If you need assistance with the return address, contact us at the email below.)

  • You are responsible for paying your own shipping costs. Shipping costs are non-refundable.
  • If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
  • For valuable items, we recommend using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We cannot guarantee receipt of your returned item without tracking.

Need Help?

📧 Email us at support@babasaleh.com with any questions regarding returns, refunds, or exchanges. We’re here to help.

Welcome to Baba Saleh Sports Egypt. For over 50 years, we have proudly served as Egypt’s leading sports shop. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency regarding how your data is collected and used when you interact with our website.

Who We Are

Our website address is: https://babasaleh.com
Baba Saleh Sports Egypt is a trusted name in sports retail, offering a wide range of athletic gear, apparel, and equipment since 1973.

Comments

When visitors leave comments on our site, we collect the data shown in the comments form, as well as the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to aid in spam detection.

An anonymized string (also called a hash) may be created from your email address and sent to the Gravatar service to determine if you are using it. You can view the Gravatar privacy policy here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. Once your comment is approved, your profile picture is visible to the public alongside your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images that include embedded location data (EXIF GPS). Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images displayed on the site.

Cookies

  • If you leave a comment, you may opt-in to saving your name, email, and website in cookies. These are for your convenience and last for one year.
  • When you visit our login page, we set a temporary cookie to check if your browser accepts cookies. It contains no personal data and is deleted when you close your browser.
  • Upon logging in, we create cookies to save your login details and display preferences. Login cookies last two days, screen options cookies last a year. Selecting “Remember Me” keeps your login active for two weeks. Logging out removes these cookies.
  • Editing or publishing an article sets an additional cookie with the post ID. This cookie contains no personal data and expires after one day.

Embedded Content from Other Websites

Articles on our site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves exactly as if you visited those websites directly.

These external sites may collect your data, use cookies, embed third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with the embedded content, especially if you are logged into an account on those sites.

Who We Share Your Data With

If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email for security purposes.

How Long We Retain Your Data

  • Comments and their metadata are stored indefinitely. This allows us to recognize and approve follow-up comments automatically.
  • For users who register on our site (if applicable), we store the personal information provided in their user profile. Users can view, edit, or delete their information at any time (except their username). Website administrators can also access and edit this information.

What Rights You Have Over Your Data

If you have an account or have left comments on our site, you may request an exported file of the personal data we hold about you. You can also request that we erase any personal data we have about you. Please note this excludes any data we are required to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

To make such a request, please contact us via our website or email our support team.

Where Your Data Is Sent

Visitor comments may be checked using an automated spam detection service to maintain the security and integrity of our site.

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how your data is handled, please don’t hesitate to contact us through our website at https://babasaleh.com.

INFORMATIONAL QUESTIONS

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Will I receive the same product that I see in the picture?

Absolutely. At Baba Saleh Sports, we take great care to ensure that the product images on our website accurately represent the actual items — including their color, design, size, and features. What you see is what you get. Our goal is to provide a transparent and trustworthy shopping experience, so you can shop with confidence knowing the product delivered to your doorstep matches the one you chose online.

Where can I view my sales receipt?

You can view and download your sales receipt from your account dashboard after logging in. It’s also automatically sent to your email after completing a purchase.

How can I return an item?

To return an item, simply contact our support team at
support@babasaleh.com within 7 days of delivery.
Make sure the item is unused, in its original packaging, and include your receipt or proof of purchase.
We’ll guide you through the return process step by step.

Will you restock items indicated as “out of stock?”

Yes, we regularly restock popular items. If a product is out of stock, we recommend checking back soon or contacting our support team for restock updates.

Where can I ship my order?

We currently deliver across all areas in Cairo, Giza, and to other governorates in Egypt. Just enter your address at checkout, and we’ll handle the rest!
